leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a sticky header that remains fixed at the top of the viewport during scrolling
Apply a sticky footer that stays positioned at the bottom of the viewport regardless of content height
Configure CSS position properties to create persistent header and footer elements
Manipulate z-index values to ensure sticky elements overlay page content appropriately
Construct a complete webpage layout using sticky positioning for both header and footer
Update existing static headers and footers to use sticky positioning behavior
Control the scroll behavior of page content while maintaining fixed header and footer elements
